verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document SCIM-based automatic provisioning of users/groups into downstream SaaS apps (Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) and on-premises apps, including a dedicated SCIM API tutorial and provisioning-triggered app gallery workflow, matching the story's push-on-access-assignment model. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-time push latency or entitlement-triggered provisioning behavior in production, and no third-party validation of reliability at scale.
